dimensions.num_rows: <int> Number of flight legs that must be covered during the scheduling period.
dimensions.num_cols: <int> Number of candidate crew rotations available for selection.

cost_vector: <list[int], length num_cols> Incremental cost of each candidate rotation, including time away from base, per diem, lodging, flying time, and deadheading expenses.

constraint_matrix_A.columns: <list[list[int]], length num_cols> For each candidate rotation, the sorted list of flight leg indices that the rotation covers.

has_base_constraints: <bool> Whether the instance includes crew base constraints enforcing labor utilization rules.

base_constraints.num_bases: <int> Number of crew bases subject to labor utilization rules.
base_constraints.num_constraints: <int> Number of base constraints enforcing crew utilization limits.

D_matrix.rows: <list[list[float]], shape [num_bases][num_cols]> Hours away from base that each rotation contributes to each crew base.

base_constraints.lower_bounds_d1: <list[float], length num_bases> Minimum required weighted hours for crew utilization at each base.
base_constraints.upper_bounds_d2: <list[float], length num_bases> Maximum allowed weighted hours for crew utilization at each base.
